blocking_gates: Obtain and inspect the official BRIDGE vector archive; verify CRS, field IDs, confidence/verification attributes, and license conditions.
Define named, non-overlapping source/target field domains before examining target benchmark outcomes; do not substitute record-density quantiles.
Declare a common target hypothesis class, label policy, feature schema, spatial resolution, mask, and physically interpretable transformations in both domains.
Use field/system-level spatial blocks for training, discriminator validation, and evaluation; prevent neighboring pixels or duplicate site records crossing partitions.
Specify source-risk estimation, the HΔH class/divergence, effective independent sample size, uncertainty intervals, and the finite-sample/class-complexity term.
Estimate or conservatively bound lambda with an independent shared-label audit; do not set it to zero by assumption.
Obtain a target-relevant, spatially blocked holdout and compare at matched emission budget before considering any submission-slot decision.
